exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Talking About a Smart Home
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: My family just moved into a smart home, and I love it.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Really? What can it do that an ordinary house cannot?

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Well, it locks the door for us when we forget and leave.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: That sounds useful. Does it save energy too?

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Yes. When everyone goes out, it switches off the lights by itself.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Amazing. How does it know when you are at home?

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: It uses sensors to tell when we come in or go out.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I'd love to live in a house like that one day.

exercises.translation_cn: 露西一家刚搬进智能家居,很喜欢;汤姆问它有何特别之处;露西说他们忘锁门时它会替他们锁门;还能省电——大家外出时自动关灯;它靠传感器判断有没有人在家;汤姆也想住进这样的房子。

questions.stem: What does Lucy's family do recently?
options: They moved into a smart home.

questions.stem: What does the home do when they forget to lock the door?
options: It locks the door for them.

questions.stem: How does the home save energy?
options: It switches off the lights when everyone goes out.
It turns off the heating only.
It asks the family to leave.
It keeps the lights on all day.

questions.stem: How does the home know when someone is in?
How does Tom feel about the smart home?
options: He would love to live in one.

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 Predictions About the Future
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Good evening. Tonight, two experts share their predictions about the future.
Dr Han believes that this time next year, more people will be travelling in driverless cars.
She also forecasts that robots will do much of our housework.
Vincent Black predicts that tiny robots will be helping doctors inside the body.
Both experts agree that we should welcome these changes rather than resist them.
exercises.translation_cn: 晚上好。今晚两位专家分享对未来的预测。韩博士认为明年此时会有更多人乘坐无人驾驶汽车;她还预测机器人将承担大量家务;文森特·布莱克预测微型机器人会在人体内协助医生;两位专家都认为我们应欢迎而非抵制这些变化。

questions.stem: What is the topic of tonight's programme?
What does Dr Han predict about driverless cars?
options: More people will be travelling in them.

questions.stem: What else does Dr Han forecast?
options: Robots will do much of our housework.

questions.stem: What does Vincent Black predict?
options: Tiny robots will fly in the sky.
Tiny robots will help doctors inside the body.

questions.stem: What do both experts agree on?
options: We should stop all new technology.

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Should We Trust Driverless Cars?
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Did you read about the driverless car accident this morning?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I did. Some people now want to oppose these cars completely.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: I understand their worry, but I'm not sure that is fair.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Why not? A passenger was hurt while the car was in driverless mode.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: True, but most accidents today are caused by tired human drivers.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: So you think the cars could actually be safer?

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Yes, if we test them carefully instead of just rejecting them.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: That makes sense. We should not stop new technology out of fear.

exercises.translation_cn: 本问安娜有没有看今早无人车事故的报道;安娜说有些人想彻底反对这种车;本理解他们的担忧但觉得不公平;安娜说有乘客在无人驾驶模式下受伤;本说如今多数事故是疲劳的人类司机造成的;安娜问那这种车会不会其实更安全;本说只要谨慎测试而非一味拒绝就可能更安全;安娜赞同,不该因恐惧而停止新技术。

questions.stem: What did Ben and Anna read about?
What do some people now want to do?
According to Ben, what causes most accidents today?
What does Ben suggest doing with the technology?
What do they finally agree on?
options: We should not stop new technology out of fear.

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 New Jobs for a New Age
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Many people worry that smart machines will take away their jobs.
It is true that artificial intelligence will do some routine work for us.
However, new technology usually creates more careers than it removes.
In the future, we will be needing people to design and repair these machines.
The best plan is not to fear the change, but to prepare for it.
exercises.translation_cn: 许多人担心智能机器会抢走工作;的确,人工智能会替我们做一些常规工作;然而,新技术通常创造的职业多于它取代的;未来我们会需要人来设计和维修这些机器;最好的办法不是惧怕变化,而是为之做准备。

questions.stem: What do many people worry about?
options: Machines will take away their jobs.

questions.stem: What kind of work will AI do for us?
What does new technology usually do to careers?
options: It creates more than it removes.

questions.stem: What kind of people will be needed in the future?
options: People to design and repair the machines.

questions.stem: What is the best plan, according to the passage?
options: To prepare for the change, not fear it.

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 A Kitchen That Obeys Your Voice
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Grace
transcript.text: Come and see my uncle's new kitchen. It understands voice commands!

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: Voice commands? So you just tell it what to do?

transcript.speaker: Grace
transcript.text: Exactly. He says 'lights on', and the kitchen obeys at once.

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: That's clever. Can it cook for him as well?

transcript.speaker: Grace
transcript.text: It can warm the oven and tell him the moment the food is ready.

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: What if something goes wrong, like a water leak?

transcript.speaker: Grace
transcript.text: Then it detects the problem and sends a warning to his phone.

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: Wow. This used to sound like a fantasy, but now it's real.

exercises.translation_cn: 格雷丝带利奥看她叔叔会听语音指令的新厨房;利奥问是不是直接吩咐它做事;格雷丝说叔叔一说'开灯',厨房立刻照做;还能预热烤箱,并在食物做好时立刻告知;利奥问万一漏水怎么办;格雷丝说它会察觉问题并向叔叔手机发警告;利奥感叹这从前像幻想,如今成真了。

questions.stem: What is special about the uncle's kitchen?
What happens when the uncle says 'lights on'?
How does the kitchen help with cooking?
options: It warms the oven and says when food is ready.

questions.stem: What does the kitchen do if there is a water leak?
options: It detects it and warns the uncle's phone.
It calls a plumber by name.

questions.stem: How does Leo feel about the kitchen?
options: It used to sound like a fantasy but is now real.

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 The Flight of the RoboBee
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Today we look at a tiny flying robot called the RoboBee.
It is being developed by a team of scientists at a famous university.
Like real bees, many RoboBees can work together as one group.
In the future, they may be helping with farming or finding people after a disaster.
The team believes that learning from nature is the key to building such machines.
exercises.translation_cn: 今天我们来看一种叫 RoboBee 的微型飞行机器人;它由一所著名大学的科学家团队研制;像真正的蜜蜂一样,许多 RoboBee 能作为一个群体协同工作;未来它们也许能帮助农业,或在灾难后寻找被困者;团队相信,向大自然学习是制造这类机器的关键。

questions.stem: What is the RoboBee?
Who is developing the RoboBee?
options: A team of scientists at a university.

questions.stem: How do many RoboBees work?
options: Each one works far away alone.
They work together as one group.

questions.stem: What might RoboBees do in the future?
options: Help with farming or find people after a disaster.

questions.stem: What does the team believe is the key to building such machines?
